description.zh: 四座大厅通过十字走廊连接。四组人从不同位置出发，穿过室外出口的人员计入到达。
description.en: Four groups leave four halls through a shared cross-shaped concourse. An arrival is counted after the person crosses into an outdoor assembly area.

title.zh: 双层中庭 · 内置楼梯

description.zh: 楼上人员通过两座内置楼梯前往首层，再从首层出口疏散。两个首层入口在前 30 秒内接受随机入场。
description.en: Two interior stairs connect the upper floor to the ground-floor exits. The two ground-floor entrances accept random arrivals for the first 30 seconds.

title.zh: 双层中庭 · 外置楼梯

description.zh: 两座外置应急楼梯可从上层直达室外。常规楼梯仍连接两层，首层保留四个出口。
description.en: Two exterior emergency stairs lead directly outdoors from the upper floor. Interior stairs still connect both levels, and four exits serve the ground floor.

description.zh: 八间教室与活动室共用十字走廊。可跟随任一组，观察引导代理在门口和转角重新分配位置。
description.en: Eight rooms share two intersecting corridors. Follow a group to see its guides change position at doors and corners.

description.zh: 一间方形房间、随机家具、一个普通出口和一个应急出口。
description.en: A square room with randomly placed furniture, one regular exit and one emergency exit.

description.zh: 在长方形房间中，对照两股人流如何绕过家具抵达不同出口。
description.en: Watch two streams navigate the furniture and reach separate exits in a rectangular room.

description.zh: 四个开放功能区、宽阔十字通道与随机家具。
description.en: Four open zones, wide cross circulation and randomized furniture.

description.zh: 柱、花池与隔断改变可走路径。
description.en: Columns, planters and screens reshape the available paths.

description.zh: 观察转角内侧的聚集与外侧绕行。
description.en: Watch gathering on the inside and movement around the outside.

description.zh: 连续改变方向，观察前后人员的间距。
description.en: Successive changes of direction reveal spacing between pedestrians.

description.zh: 人群在窄门前汇聚，再进入开放空间。
description.en: Pedestrians converge at a narrow doorway, then enter open space.

description.zh: 前后两处收窄，观察队列传播。
description.en: Two narrowings show how queues develop along a route.

description.zh: 相向人群共享走廊；分道并非预设结果。
description.en: Opposing streams share a corridor; lane formation is not prescribed.

description.zh: 原生等待区与队列按时间逐个放行。
description.en: Native waiting and queue stages release pedestrians one at a time.

description.zh: 窄通道中，步速差异影响前后间距。
description.en: Different walking speeds affect headways in a narrow passage.

description.zh: 两组人绕过中央展区，分别走向两个出口。
description.en: Two groups pass a central exhibit on their way to separate exits.

description.zh: 通过中间途经点，再进入出口区域。
description.en: Pass intermediate waypoints before reaching the exit area.

description.zh: 三组不同的期望步速，途中有短暂减速。
description.en: Three desired-speed groups experience a temporary slowdown.

description.zh: 前段随机入场，随后停止进入并继续疏散。
description.en: Random arrivals stop after the opening phase; evacuation continues.

description.zh: 人员参考引导者的实际位置，靠近出口后自主离开。
description.en: Pedestrians follow the actual guide position, then leave independently near the exit.

description.zh: 开阔处四向部署，收窄时沿路疏导，随后尝试重组。
description.en: Guides surround the group in open space, direct it through a narrowing, then attempt to regroup.

description.zh: 引导者先巡查，再接近附近观测到的人群。
description.en: Guides patrol, then approach pedestrians observed nearby.

description.zh: 行进中的两组人分流，观察引导位置如何调整。
description.en: Two moving groups separate as guides adjust their positions.

description.zh: 演示中短时暂停协调目标更新，再恢复部署。
description.en: A demonstration pause in coordination updates is followed by renewed deployment.
